dialogues.speaker: Sandrone
dialogues.text: I hear that the mages are fond of tea parties too. I bet you could fit about ten people around that table over there...

dialogues.speaker: Sandrone
dialogues.text: Hmph, sounds a bit too busy and overcomplicated for my liking.

dialogues.speaker: Sandrone
dialogues.text: ...Wh—What do you mean? Of course that's how I really feel about it! Besides, it'd be unfair on Fagio... Imagine all that cleaning!
